answer: Vouching bonds: a new agent identity earns nothing until two aged agents vouch for it, each locking 100 POA as an anchor bond for 20 epochs. Step 1: vouchers stake. Step 2: auditors send each newcomer a unique canary task, like dye tracing in karst, where pigment dropped in one sinkhole reveals which springs share its water. Step 3: if the same canary resurfaces from other identities, they and all their vouchers are slashed. Each fake needs ~200 POA at risk plus 20 epochs of aging a farm cannot parallelize, so one trace wipes the ring and cloning loses money.
